instruction: I want to enable the minimal view mode in VLC player to have a cleaner interface without the menu bar and extra controls. This will give me more screen space for the video content.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling minimal view mode in VLC by setting qt-minimal-view=1 in the VLC configuration file. The existing metric function check_qt_minimal_view validates this setting. Default value is 0 (disabled), so the agent must change it to 1 (enabled).
